codeReview.summary: The feature adds substantial speedup reconciliation logic and evidence reporting, but two blocking defects remain: one extracted narrative speedup claim is not validated due to narrow pair parsing, and failure runs return before writing reconciliation_report.json.

issues.description: Narrative pair extraction is too narrow (only 'A vs B' / 'A is ... faster than B'). The memo line 'While rust-ag achieved a 2.0× speedup over the original ag' is extracted as a speedup claim but cannot map a pair, so it is skipped instead of validated. Evidence: publication/ragas_blog_memo.md:365 and publication/reconciliation_report.json:77-83 show this claim as skipped, violating the expected behavior to validate extracted narrative speedup claims against benchmark ratios.

On reconciliation failure, the function returns before writing publication/reconciliation_report.json (write happens at line 883+). This means fail cases can leave stale/missing report evidence, conflicting with expected behavior that reconciliation_report.json includes explicit speedup-claim pass/fail evidence.

reconcile_speedup_table() accepts a tolerance parameter (line 497) and callers pass --speedup-tolerance (line 809), but comparison uses hardcoded table_tol=0.02. This makes the function signature/CLI coupling misleading.

sharedStateObservations.observation: publication-worker SKILL.md does not reinforce AGENTS test-first requirement, which likely enabled implementation-before-tests flow in this session.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: AGENTS.md:17 requires strict test-first workflow; .factory/skills/publication-worker/SKILL.md Work Procedure (line 14+) has no test-first step; worker-transcripts.jsonl:90 shows multiple Tool: Edit operations on publication/reconcile_metrics.py before 'Now let me write a proper test file' and creation of publication/tests/test_reconcile_speedups.py.

sharedStateObservations.observation: The new publication speedup test suite is not represented in .factory/services.yaml commands, so workers run ad-hoc pytest commands for this area.

summary: Review failed. The commit implements the core reconciliation feature, but it does not reliably validate all extracted narrative speedup claims and does not persist reconciliation_report.json on failure paths, leaving expected fail evidence incomplete.
